text:
IncidentBot: alert: kv_cache.metadata_errors spiked 520% vs baseline at 10:12 UTC. Automated mitigation: throttling continuous-batcher on prod-zn. Creating thread for triage and handoff.
Maria G.: I'm on-call, digging in. Seeing KV blockmgr mem pressure and a burst of small writes. Any recent deploys to batcher/blockmgr?
Raj P.: rolled out batching v2 config yesterday morning to reduce tail lat — /configs/continuous-batcher:v2. Might be related. Reverting to v1 is an option if needed.
Sophie L.: attaching snippet from host-45 logs. pastebin: https://paste.redwood/internal/abc123
Sophie L.: ```
2026-03-15T10:11:58Z blockmgr: allocate block id=0x7f2 size=64MB
2026-03-15T10:12:02Z kv_cache: metadata entries increased by 120k
2026-03-15T10:12:07Z continuous-batcher: flush_count=4320 duration_ms=3100
``` 
Kevin T.: customer-impact check: CS reported elevated error rates for two enterprise tenants in EMEA, tickets incoming. Pinning: acme-corp, monolith-inc.
Maria G.: initial mitigation: toggled `continuous-batcher.rate_limit` to 0.5 on prod-zn (reduced throughput). Seeing immediate drop in new metadata entries.
OpsBot: automation note — rate limit toggle applied via /run playbook kv-burst-throttle. playbook run id: pb-7782
Raj P.: we need to consider block size. v2 uses dynamic block sizing which appears to fragment metadata. Quick hotfix: force blockmgr.block_size=8MB (was dynamic). I can cut a config roll.
Sophie L.: confirm: dynamic block sizing is causing many small metadata objects which blow up the block index. Repro locally with loadgen-3.
Maria G.: I'm going to open a canary rollback PR for continuous-batcher to v1 and request immediate deploy. @DeployBot can you take a canary?
DeployBot: deploying canary v1 to prod-zn-small (10% traffic) — job id deploy-5591. Estimated < 3 minutes.
Raj P.: if canary looks good, promote to 100% then roll blockmgr block_size change as safer long-term fix.
Kevin T.: notified CS, sent initial customer advisory: "We are mitigating an infrastructure issue that may cause transient 5xxs. We'll update in 30m." :email:
Sophie L.: another data point: kv_metadata table growth correlates with continuous-batcher flush spikes and a new path that writes extra metadata for compacted batches.
Maria G.: can we apply a temporary GC aggressiveness increase? `blockmgr.gc_threshold=0.6 -> 0.4` to free blocks faster?
Raj P.: yes, but GC is expensive. Prefer throttling batcher + rollback first. If memory remains high, we'll nudge GC.
OpsBot: auto-snapshot of affected nodes taken: snap-2251234567-ephemeral. Logs archived to s3://redwood-ops/incident-2251234567/
DeployBot: canary promoted to 100% at 10:28 UTC. No regression in latency metrics after 5m. Deploy id deploy-5591 -> promoted.
Maria G.: metrics: metadata growth rate back down to baseline in prod-zn; 5xxs decreased to normal for most routes. Two enterprise tenants still seeing intermittent failures — investigating targeted routing.
Kevin T.: CS updated customers with a follow-up note and asked for postmortem timeline. Tracking: CS-5489, CS-5490.
Sophie L.: root cause hypothesis: v2 batching path introduced additional per-batch metadata writes (edge case with tiny-batch fallback). It interacts poorly with dynamic block allocation causing index blowup.
Raj P.: immediate next steps: 1) revert continuous-batcher to v1 (done), 2) set blockmgr.block_size=8MB on prod-zn (scheduled), 3) review v2 batching path code for metadata writes.
Maria G.: scheduling block_size change now as a staged config roll with 2m pauses between hosts. Applying to low-traffic AZ first.
TJ (ops lead): Handoff for night shift at 13:00 UTC: mitigations in place (v1 rollback + throttling), block_size roll is in progress. Open action items: follow-up eval of v2, add unit test for metadata write path, confirm customer ticket closures. Please include performance diffs for token throughput and 95p latency.
Kevin T.: marking CS tickets as "investigating -> mitigation in place" and will confirm reopens if customers still see errors.
Sophie L.: I'll capture a small repro and submit a draft PR with a fix for redundant metadata writes: https://git.redwood/repo/pulls/2857 (WIP)
Maria G.: monitoring: set synthetic alert to trigger if metadata growth > 2x baseline for 15m. Also lowered continuous-batcher concurrency on prod-zn until patch validated.
OpsBot: scheduled follow-up runbook review: /runbooks/kv-cache-paged (owners: eng-runtime, eng-sre). Please update with 3 mitigation knobs we used.
DeployBot: config roll complete at 11:32 UTC: blockmgr.block_size set to 8MB across prod-zn. Confirmed no immediate regressions.
Maria G.: closing immediate incident state. Moving to investigation->postmortem thread. If anyone sees residual spikes, ping me directly. :thumbsup:
TJ (ops lead): thanks all. Drafting a short postmortem and assigning follow-ups: SLO review, regression tests, CS postmortem note. Handoff complete.
